quarterly_data.quarter: Recursion Bank of America SMID Cap Virtual Conference 2026 (08-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO and President Ben Taylor on the operating model: 'about 65% plus of our budget is actually applied' - even platform and technology development is done on real programs, so Recursion learns whether its models work. Partnerships are designed so Recursion is always at breakeven or profit on a direct cost basis because Sanofi, Roche and its other partners pay ahead of time for its expenses; he said Recursion does not want to become a service company and runs its partnerships the same way as its internal programs.
quarterly_data.figure: about 65% plus of budget applied to real programs

quarterly_data.quarter: Recursion Bank of America SMID Cap Virtual Conference 2026 (08-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: REC-4881 (FAP), CFO Ben Taylor: FAP patients undergo on average about 10 major surgeries and about 70 treatments with excisions over their lifetime. He said Recursion is 'the first drug to ever show that you could take the patient off drug and maintain that response', with a slight deepening of response over three months off drug, and that the effect is seen in both upper and lower GI, whereas eRapa (encapsulated rapamycin) showed a little under a 20% response after 12 months, all in the lower GI. For the FDA discussions on pivotal design (described as productive), Recursion built an LLM model using over 250,000 patient records to study standard clinical practice and created a natural history database with a university in the Netherlands that tracked FAP patients over 20 years, showing continuous annual polyp growth averaging 'north of 50%'; he said Recursion would be fine even with the same trial design as the existing trial. Longer follow-up and data on managing known MEK1/2 side effects will be presented at the November FAP conference.
quarterly_data.figure: about 10 major surgeries and about 70 excision treatments per lifetime; eRapa a little under 20% response after 12 months; LLM on over 250,000 patient records; 20-year natural history database, annual polyp growth north of 50%

quarterly_data.quarter: Recursion Bank of America SMID Cap Virtual Conference 2026 (08-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Oncology pipeline, CFO Ben Taylor: the PI3K inhibitor program is IND cleared and should be starting phase I soon; it showed no stomatitis signals so far and looked very clean in preclinical studies, with 'more than an order of magnitude more selectivity over the other compounds in the space'. The RBM39 degrader (REC-1245) is a first-in-class program brought into the clinic with an early PK/PD profile he called really exciting; an update comes in the second half of this year. He listed CDK7, LSD1 and PI3K among programs coming into the clinic beyond REC-4881 and RBM39.
quarterly_data.figure: more than an order of magnitude more selectivity (PI3K inhibitor)

connects_to.relationship: AI-discovered neuroscience targets and joint drug discovery

contracts.source: Recursion Bank of America SMID Cap Virtual Conference 2026 (08-11-2026)
contracts.signal: CFO Ben Taylor: the Roche partnership has an original 10-year term that can be extended and is about halfway through, with up to 40 design programs Recursion can advance. Roche can query the two optioned neuroscience maps (neuronal and microglial cells) but does not get the data. From map queries Recursion selected targets, validated them experimentally in disease models with Roche, and is now designing the molecule for the first validated target. Roche wants Recursion to do all of the chemistry and drug-design work; work is also ongoing in GI oncology. He said the Roche design-program economics are similar to Sanofi's, 'not quite as high on the economics, but close'.
contracts.units: up to 40 design programs; 10-year term, about halfway through
contracts.type: AI target-discovery and drug-design collaboration - terms and status

contracts.source: Recursion Bank of America SMID Cap Virtual Conference 2026 (08-11-2026)
contracts.signal: CFO Ben Taylor: the Sanofi collaboration is a legacy Exscientia deal with no target-ID portion, aimed at targets no one has drugged before. Five programs have hit their first discovery milestone; the next milestone for each is Sanofi opting in to take it forward into clinical trials, which ends Recursion's operational obligations, and payments from development candidate onwards are 'basically profit'. Royalties average in the low double digits. He hopes Recursion gets 'across the line with our first development candidate with Sanofi'.
contracts.units: five programs past first discovery milestone
contracts.value: royalties average in the low double digits
